title: HoldoutResult
description: Records the result of a single-use holdout evaluation stage (Improvement 06). Consumed once per hypothesis; status=fail is terminal per A6.1.

hypothesis_id.description: Identifier of the hypothesis being evaluated.

holdout_window.description: The date range used for holdout evaluation.

expected_range.description: Pre-registered performance expectations, locked in BEFORE evaluation is run.

min_sharpe.description: Lower bound of acceptable Sharpe ratio.

max_sharpe.description: Upper bound of acceptable Sharpe ratio.

rationale.description: Justification for the chosen expected range, written before evaluation.

status.description: Outcome of the holdout evaluation. 'fail' is terminal per A6.1 — no further promotion path exists.

consumed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recording when the holdout was spent. This evaluation cannot be repeated.

holdout_sharpe.description: Sharpe ratio measured over the holdout window. Null when closed trade count < 5 per A3.4 null-floor rule.

holdout_max_drawdown.description: Maximum drawdown measured over the holdout window. Null when trade count is insufficient.

walk_forward_sharpe_for_comparison.description: Walk-forward Sharpe used as a reference baseline for degradation calculation.

degradation_pct.description: Percentage degradation from walk-forward Sharpe to holdout Sharpe. Null when either Sharpe is null.

per_trade_expectancy.description: Statistical summary of per-trade returns over the holdout window.

mean_bps.description: Mean return per trade in basis points.

se_bps.description: Standard error of mean return in basis points.

t_stat.description: t-statistic for the mean return (mean_bps / se_bps).

n_trades.description: Number of closed trades in the holdout window.

within_expected_range.description: True if holdout_sharpe falls within [expected_range.min_sharpe, expected_range.max_sharpe]. Null when holdout_sharpe is null.

notes.description: Free-text notes on anomalies, caveats, or follow-up actions.
